interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin bundle that projects retained Codex Cortex architecture skills and ECC (affaan-m/ECC) architecture skills into an installable marketplace shape. Includes CQRS, event-driven architecture, database design, ADRs, backend patterns, Docker, hexagonal architecture, intent-driven development, Kubernetes, MCP server patterns, and MLE workflow.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the Architecture Pack bundle and source map.

Use the bundle to install the Codex Cortex projections (cqrs-event-sourcing, event-driven-architecture, database-design-patterns) and ECC projections (architecture-decision-records, backend-patterns, docker-patterns, hexagonal-architecture, intent-driven-development, kubernetes-patterns, mcp-server-patterns, mle-workflow).
Compare the bundle versioning against the retained Codex Cortex custody surface and ECC custody surface.
